query: Can I file an FIR online in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Filing an FIR Online in Tamil Nadu:
Yes, you can file an e-FIR for certain crimes like theft, loss of documents, and cybercrime through the Tamil Nadu Police website or the Citizen Portal.
answer: To file an FIR online in Tamil Nadu, you need to visit the official website of the Tamil Nadu Police or use the e-Filing portal. [Document 1]
